organic_results.title: Upgrade Guide: Next.js 15 - Next.js Docs
organic_results.snippet: In Next.js 15, asynchronous request-specific data access is enforced. params and searchParams in page.js, layout.js, and route handlers are now Promises. You must await params before accessing properties, e.g. const { slug } = await params.

organic_results.title: Dynamic Routes: params - Next.js Docs
organic_results.snippet: params is a promise that resolves to an object containing dynamic route parameters. In Next.js 15, accessing params synchronously is deprecated and will trigger a warning.

organic_results.title: Next.js 15 Release Notes - GitHub
organic_results.snippet: Breaking Changes: Asynchronous Page and Layout params. Previously params was a synchronous prop. In v15 it is an async Promise to prepare for future partial prerendering.
